messages:
maria: Customer reporting 400 on /v1/embeddings — error shows dimension mismatch when they send a single item. Customer payload attached.

maria: Error from API: InvalidEmbeddingShape: expected 2D array [batch, tokens], got depth=3

maria: Payload they sent:
```json
{ \"model\": \"text-embedding-3-small\", \"input\": [[ \"Customer text goes here\" ]] }
```

alex: Can you paste a curl we can run? Also need request_id and region.

maria: request_id: r-0a1b2c3d, region: us-west-2

maria: repro curl:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{\"model\":\"text-embedding-3-small\",\"input\":[[\"single text\"]]}'
```

jordan: Looks like a client double-wrap. Common in JS when code does `Array.of(s)` or serializes an already-batched payload. Suggest adding quick server-side validation that rejects depth>2 with helpful error. Also adding an SDK guard to flatten nested single-item arrays.

grace: Customer also saw a temporary billing spike due to retries; logged a billing ticket: bill-7742. We should confirm no double-charges.

alex: Quick fix plan:
- eng: add validation + clearer 400 message (trace r-0a1b2c3d). (jordan)
- devex: add example in embeddings docs for single vs batch. (maria)
- support: notify customer that we can safely re-run without extra charge and give repro fix. (maria)

maria: I'll send update to customer now. Can we prioritize SDK guard in next patch? :pray: 

jordan: will PR a small client-side guard today and add unit test for nested arrays. :shipit: 

logs-bot: matched request r-0a1b2c3d — 400 InvalidEmbeddingShape — latency 210ms — user-agent: example-js/1.2.3

maria: Thanks team :heart:
